usage:

evidence.reason: Left edit removes metering.initialize() and changes evaluate call to (units, undefined, "benchmark"), altering the multiplier and plan relied on by the test assertion subscriptionCharge(40) > 0.
Right edit changes default multiplier from configuration.rate to 0, so callers relying on the default (including evaluate/usageQuote paths) now compute with multiplier 0, changing charge amounts.
Test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") > 0; the merged edits change the multiplier/plan inputs these assertions depend on.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动分别改变了订阅计费的初始化、乘数与计划参数，以及 usageCharge 的默认乘数，合并后可能使订阅计费结果与测试预期不符，但缺少 configuration.rate、chargeUnit 与 evaluate 对 undefined 的处理等关键信息，无法完全确定。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 的修改者恢复 metering.initialize() 并明确传入有效的 multiplier 与 plan（如 0.1 与 "monthly"），或由 src/metering.ts#usageCharge 的修改者确认默认 multiplier 改为 0 是否与 evaluate 的调用约定一致后再合并。
